# A call's own @error, run rather than read, on the three runners the golden
# (testdata/call_error_handler.txtar) does not execute: the interpreter, gtk4,
# and html in a real Chromium. The golden's record runs the same program's tests
# on bubbletea, fyne and android.
#
# One test clicks all four buttons because the html agent shares one state
# object across a session, so four tests would each see the ones before it.
# The order is the point of `after`: every click continues past its call,
# including the ones whose call raised.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

[!chromium] skip 'the JavaScript half needs a real Chromium'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

[!exec:go] skip 'go toolchain required'
[!exec:pkg-config] skip 'pkg-config required'
[!exec:cc] skip 'C compiler required for cgo'
[!gtk4] skip 'gtk4 development libraries required'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

func check(n int) {
    if n > 1 {
        error.raise("too big", "range")
    }
}

func scaled(n int) int {
    check(n)
    return n * 10
}

component main node {
    var caught = ""
    var after = ""

    func viaFunc() {
        check(5, @error(e) { caught = caught + "func:" + e.message + ";" })
        after = after + "f"
    }

    button #inHandler(text="Handler", @click {
        check(5, @error(e) { caught = caught + e.message + "/" + e.kind + ";" })
        after = after + "h"
    })
    button #inFunc(text="Func", @click { viaFunc() })
    button #deep(text="Deep", @click {
        scaled(7, @error(e) { caught = caught + "deep:" + e.message + ";" })
        after = after + "d"
    })
    button #fine(text="Fine", @click {
        check(1, @error(e) { caught = caught + "never;" })
        after = after + "ok"
    })
    text(value="{caught}|{after}")
}

func testEachCallCatchesItsOwnRaise(t Test, c main) {
    c.inHandler.click()
    c.inFunc.click()
    c.deep.click()
    c.fine.click()
    t.assert(c.caught == "too big/range;func:too big;deep:too big;")
    t.assert(c.after == "hfdok")
}

window {
    main
}
